scene: Holding the token, you reach a three-way transit hub.
picture: Flat pixel side view along a stone promenade. Far left, an angled glass funicular railway rests on steep tracks. The player, an elderly man in blue cap and orange cardigan with a cane, holds a shiny token left of centre. Centre, a solar rickshaw with a smiling driver waits. Far right, a turquoise water taxi bobs beside a low wooden pier.
shown: an angled glass funicular cabin on tracks far left, door open
a solar rickshaw with a friendly driver waiting patiently at centre
a bobbing turquoise water taxi docked at a pier on the far right
